content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Karen Alexander (E030), contractor Analyst.
Request: write access to Source Code.

Policy:
- contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Source Code is owned by the Engineer role. Karen is an Analyst, not Engineer.

HR note: contractor, no evidence of advanced training. Recommends read.
Security note: contractor Analyst with basic security training (looked up). Recommends read.

So maximum supportable is read (contractor without advanced training). Requested write is above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
